create_KronosPredictor: create a KronosPredictor instance with a loaded model, tokenizer, device, and max context length
run_prediction: run time-series price prediction using KronosPredictor with historical OHLC data and timestamp inputs
build_KronosTokenizer: build a KronosTokenizer by loading the pretrained NeoQuasar/Kronos-Tokenizer-base from Hugging Face
build_KronosModel: build a Kronos model by loading the pretrained NeoQuasar/Kronos-small from Hugging Face
plot_prediction: plot predicted versus ground truth close prices on a matplotlib line chart
